fieldValues.title: What happens to the 304 duplicate pairs?
fieldValues.thinking_reached: No option chosen. Raised as an open question in Research (1. What affirmation costs today), 2026-10-30, and turned into an exercise so options are explored before any decision.
fieldValues.tensions:
Options, none chosen:
- A. Collapse each pair into one record; affirmation becomes a state on it.
- B. Keep the affirmed copy as the tip and retire the suggestion.
- C. Keep both, and stop forking new ones.
- D. Leave everything as it is.
fieldValues.unresolved_questions: What canon(), the desk and the care policy read from the pairs, and what breaks if a copy disappears.
fieldValues.next_action: List every reader of Affirmed membership and derived-from in clerk and the programme.
